name: web-modernize
description: Guides teams through migrating legacy web applications (ASP.NET WebForms, Java/JSP, AngularJS 1.x, etc.) to modern stacks. Provides slash commands for analyze (exhaustive entry-point discovery), plan (with a dependency graph), scaffold (legacy-asset copy + toolchain preflight), unit-by-unit migration, behavioural-parity and security review, advisory migration-quality (idiomatic-code) review, rollback, retry, sync, status (with staleness checks), and progress reporting. State is split across per-unit files for multi-developer concurrency.
